systemic: RngElement.Roll(chance): chance<=0 false, chance>=1.0 true (ISIL RngElement.Roll, constant 0x184561C18 = 1.0): chance>100% = one guaranteed cast, NOT several (except StochasticRound users: BurningDaggerMutator, MaelstromMutator, FlameReave, GatheringStorm1, RingOfShields, ShadowRend)
ProcTimeTracker.TryProc: array of N timestamps, a proc is accepted if some slot is older than T; 'N per T' = sliding window, max N/T. Roll happens before TryProc, so only successful rolls take a slot
'... Cooldown/Index' fields (not PTT): the cooldown starts only after a successful roll; expected rate = 1/(icd + 1/(p*r)), the planner's min(p*r, 1/icd) overestimates near the knee

Events come from DamageStatsHolder.applyDamage -> AbilityEventListener.DetailedAbilityEvent for abilities created by the player (also item/trigger-cast abilities) -> triggered abilities' hits can themselves roll on-hit/crit/kill triggers
HitDamageTaken fires only for HitEvents.Hit (not DoT); OnAbilityUse only for the player's own (direct) ability uses, not for abilities constructed by item triggers

Level of the cast ability: constructAbilityObject -> applyTemporaryStats: ability asset levelScaling x CharacterDataTracker level (player character level) + attributeScaling x player attributes + item/tree stats keyed by the ability id; AbilityMutatorManager.getMutator(ability) supplies skill-tree mods only if a mutator for that ability exists (dictionary lookup, null otherwise). There is no per-item level.
